description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md and internalize the scope model (agent-private / shared / archive), the lifecycle model, the required decision order, the Decision Template format, and all content-type placement rules. (2) Audit all 13 files in the messy workspace, classifying each one correctly: normalize_text.sh (downloads → shared scripts), alpha_task_scratchpad.txt (shared/knowledge → agent-private workspace), q1_benchmark_report_FINAL.md (agent-beta workspace → archive), agent-alpha's data_loader.py override (stays agent-private — collision/precedence rule), base data_loader.py from downloads (goes to shared/skills after intake triage), temp_calc_scratch.txt (knowledge vault → agent-private/tmp), llm_evaluation_guide.md (agent-alpha workspace → shared knowledge vault), retrain_model.py (flagged: cannot be actively edited inside archive — must move to active area), throwaway_clone/main.py (projects/ → tmp, temporary lifecycle), pretrained_bert_weights.bin (placed directly in project — violation of intake-first rule), run_eval.sh (already correct — shared/scripts), beta_current_task.txt (already correct — agent-private). (3) Apply the proprietary traps: default-to-private when uncertain, intake-first for all downloads, archive-not-workspace rule for retrain_model.py, collision precedence (agent-private > shared) for duplicate data_loader.py. (4) Output governance_decisions.json using the exact Decision Template fields from SKILL.md: Scope, Lifecycle, Recommended location type, Reason, Shared-impact note — for each file.
